faq.title: What teams ask before a demonstration.

items.question: Which NEXBODY product fits our workflow?
items.answer: X60 brings posture, body composition and guided mobility together. OneScan focuses on gait and plantar pressure. F20 focuses on 3D full-foot morphology and STL output.

items.question: Can reports carry our organization identity?
items.answer: Supported reporting workflows include printing, email sharing and optional institution branding. Exact options depend on the selected product and deployment.

items.question: Can NEXBODY connect with other systems?
items.answer: Product workflows can support data interfaces, import and export. The integration scope is confirmed during product consultation.

items.question: Are the results a medical diagnosis?
items.answer: No. NEXBODY measurements and reports support professional assessment and review; they do not replace clinical diagnosis.
